svg.title: Guitar control circuit schematic
svg.desc: Schematic of a passive guitar control circuit. Neck and middle single coils and a two-coil bridge humbucker feed a four-pole five-way selector. A four-pole phase toggle reverses the neck coil and picks the bridge coil used in the centre position. A series toggle joins the selected pair end to end. The pickups return through a piezo disc with a level rheostat across it, and a piezo toggle shorts either the disc or the pickups. Master tone, master volume and the output jack follow, with ground along the bottom.
